cards.card_text: Foreigners uncircumcised in heart and flesh Priests of Baal from Samaria Soldiers sent by the king of Babylon
cards.verse_text: In addition to all your other abominations, you brought in foreigners uncircumcised in both heart and flesh to occupy My sanctuary; you defiled My temple when you offered My food—the fat and the blood; you broke My covenant.

cards.card_text: The Lord GOD says even a foreigner who lives among the Israelites may not enter His sanctuary if he is uncircumcised in heart and flesh.
cards.verse_text: This is what the Lord GOD says: No foreigner uncircumcised in heart and flesh may enter My sanctuary—not even a foreigner who lives among the Israelites.
